description.narrative: The project entails the creation of a funding facility to support greenfield development over the 2007-2012 period of five hotels, which would be operated under the Marriott Courtyard brand, and one hotel, which would be operated under the Marriott Residence Inn brand, in the following locations: - Managua, Nicaragua; - San Jose, Costa Rica; - near the San Jose International Airport, Costa Rica; - Playa del Coco, Guanacaste, Costa Rica; - Kingston, Jamaica; and - Bridgetown, Barbados. The project will address the shortage of quality mid-tier hotel rooms in the relevant local markets. The hotels will be constructed and owned by specially-incorporated hotel development companies, which will be controlled by Caribe Hospitality S.A., the sponsor of the project (see the details below) and minority-owned by IFC and local investors.

The project will help meet increasing demand for high-quality mid-tier hotels linked by common management and onward reservations in Costa Rica, Jamaica, Barbados and Nicaragua. It will make a significant contribution in the improvement of the business hotel infrastructure especially in Managua, Nicaragua; Playa del Coco, Costa Rica and Kingston, Jamaica, where the level of such infrastructure is noticeably lower than in other project locations. The expansion of business hotel chains will, in its turn, support local trade and business development. In addition, the Caribe Hospitality concept ran by Central American sponsors, has an important development impact in demonstrating that regional investment schemes, when supported by cross-border capital can be successfully implemented in Central America and the Caribbean. Through their participation in the hotel companies, local and regional investors are also able to expand and diversify their business activities.

name.narrative: The six properties are expected to be located in the following markets: - Costa Rica: - Residence Inn: San Rafael, Escazu (San Jose metropolitan area). The 28,000 square feet site for the proposed Residence Inn is located within a large mixed-use project under development by the sponsors other real-estate company. The overall development comprises the Residence Inn, leased office space, residential condominium lofts, a medical center, a health club and movie theaters. The site is directly opposite the Courtyard San Jose built by the sponsors in 2002. The property is adjacent to the IFC-financed CIMA hospital as well. - Marriott Courtyard near the San Jose international airport: Alajuela, greater San Jose Metropolitan Area. The site for the Courtyard comprises a vacant lot situated on the main road between the town of Alajuela and the San Jose International Airport. The city is located 14 miles west of San Jose but, due to the extensive urban and industrial sprawl, it falls within the Central Valleys metropolitan area. - Marriott Courtyard in Playa Del Coco, on the Pacific Coast of Costa Rica, Guanacaste province: close to several of the new, large integrated resort developments in this region. The Courtyard will be part of a mixed use development covering 3,000m2 of beachfront land to include a plaza with restaurants and a retail center. It is located in a small, under-developed fishing village. As part of the overall development Caribe Hospitality and its sister real estate company hope to help regenerate this small village and plan to rebuild/improve a local park adjacent to the hotel/retail development. - Nicaragua: Marriott Courtyard in Managua: The site for the Courtyard comprises a vacant lot on the main highway in the Bolonia section of Managua, the capital and largest city in Nicaragua; while this area was once a residential district, since the old center city was destroyed by an earthquake in 1972, most of the new development (offices, banks, embassies) has taken place towards this part of the city; the Courtyard will be adjacent to the new headquarters of the largest bank in Nicaragua, BANPRO, two-three freestanding restaurants, an existing PriceSmart store and a small shopping center. - Jamaica: Marriott Courtyard in Kingston: CH and their partners are currently looking for a site. - Barbados: Marriott Courtyard in Barbados: The proposed Courtyard is located in the town of Hastings on the southern coast of the island, about two miles south of the capital, Bridgetown This is the Historic Garrison District of Barbados with a mix of small to mid-size hotels, restaurants, retail shops and some office space. The site is located on the main coastal highway but across the street from the beach.
